---
title: "MCQPy Web"
filters:
  - shinylive
---

This page embeds the MCQPy Shinylive quiz app directly with a small Quarto
`shinylive-python` block.

The app code is now simple enough that no embed generator is needed. The block just
imports `mcqpy_shiny.embed_app.create_app` and installs the published wheels it needs.

The preview site is published under `/shiny/`, while the wheel artifacts are published under
`/wheels/` on the same Pages deployment.

:::{.column-screen-inset}
```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 800
## file: app.py
from mcqpy_shiny.embed_app import create_app

app = create_app(
    fixed_url=None,
    fixed_token=None,
    allow_manual_load=True,
    title='MCQPy Quiz',
    card_width='900px',
)
## file: requirements.txt
shiny>=1.2.1
pydantic
mcqpy-core
mcqpy-shiny
```
:::
